**Changed path:** `tests/realtime-ui.test.tsx`, which is inside `owns_paths`. No product code changed.

**Cause:** commit `b04482a` (council-office-desktop-fixes) changed `src/rooms/council/ui/council-page.tsx` so that the desktop layout is chosen by `window.innerWidth` (≥ 1024) instead of the measured block width. In jsdom the window is 1024 wide, so the page renders the office layout. There the feed is only inside the drawer, which starts collapsed. The commit updated `tests/council-page.test.tsx` but not this realtime test, so `council-messages` was no longer in the DOM.

**Why the test changed and not the product:** the commit's intent is the desktop office layout, and the sibling tests assert the feed is absent while the drawer is collapsed. Keeping the feed in the DOM would contradict them. So the test now follows the layout: it waits for `council-peek`, clicks `council-drawer-toggle`, and then runs the same assertions. No assertion was removed or weakened.

**Results:**
- `npx vitest run tests/realtime-ui.test.tsx` → exit 0, 3/3 passed. I ran it three times in total, and all passed.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` → exit 0.

I did not run `tests/council-page.test.tsx`, since this change does not touch its code path.
